stem: Two spectra deliver the same PPFD but produce different plant architecture. What does this demonstrate?
choices: Photon quantity alone does not describe all photobiological responses; spectral distribution can affect morphology
The PPFD meters must be broken
Spectrum determines yield independently of genotype and environment
rationale: Equal PPFD does not mean equal spectral composition. Cannabis morphology can respond to spectrum, with effects also depending on genotype and context.
